sections.title: MindTopo: Can Foundation Models Reason in Topological Space?
sections.abstract: MindTopo evaluates foundation models on topology at static reasoning and closed-loop planning levels, finding a large model-human gap and unreliable preservation of topology during rollouts.
sections.claimed_contribution: A cognitively grounded topology benchmark with 11,030 instances across five properties and two cognitive levels.
sections.caveat: Results may depend on the generated task families and tested models.

sections.title: Mr.LHDR: A Benchmark for Multimodal Real-World Long-Horizon Deep Research Agents
sections.abstract: Mr.LHDR tests long dependency-heavy multimodal investigations and finds only 43.1% overall and 34.3% strict accuracy for the strongest tested system.
sections.claimed_contribution: An eight-category benchmark scoring final answers and intermediate conclusions over hidden evidence graphs.
sections.caveat: Pilot benchmark results may change with broader model and task coverage.

sections.title: Sci-MMR: Benchmarking Multi-Step Evidence-Grounded Scientific Reasoning in Multimodal Agents
sections.abstract: Sci-MMR tests evidence acquisition, integration, and verification with citation-linked argument graphs and visual evidence, finding answer accuracy exceeds complete-evidence recovery by more than 20%.
sections.claimed_contribution: A 235-task benchmark spanning four scientific disciplines and multi-panel figures.
sections.caveat: Gold-evidence interventions diagnose bottlenecks but do not establish tool generalization.

sections.title: Magenta: Closing the Loop Between Mathematical Reasoning and Lean Verification
sections.abstract: Magenta converts natural-language mathematics into Lean statements and machine-checked proofs, using judges to validate formalization and route failures.
sections.claimed_contribution: A training-free verification-in-the-loop pipeline with reported perfect accuracy on the evaluated olympiad suites.
sections.caveat: The reported results are restricted to the evaluated suites and model configurations.

sections.title: COBRA-Skills: Contextual Bandit-Guided Evolution for Agent Skill Optimization
sections.abstract: COBRA-Skills uses contextual-bandit prioritization and evidence-grounded skill evolution to reduce evaluation cost while improving agent performance.
sections.claimed_contribution: Reported strongest average performance among compared methods with 55–58% lower optimization cost than SkillOpt.
sections.caveat: The abstract does not establish performance beyond the six benchmarks and three models.

sections.title: From Parameters to Answers: How LLMs Retrieve and Use Their Internal Knowledge
sections.abstract: Layerwise interventions across Qwen, Llama, and Gemma separate query routing from answer-content dependence and reveal architecture-dependent causal windows.
sections.claimed_contribution: A distinction between readability, causal steering, direction strength, and later content dependence in internal knowledge use.
sections.caveat: The abstract reports selected question families, so broader domain generalization remains open.
